description: Audit an MTA-STS policy against the MX hosts it is meant to authorise. Reports an MX host no pattern matches, which under enforce mode refuses every message to that host; testing or none mode, where nothing is enforced; a max_age under a day, where a receiver that cannot fetch the policy stops honouring it almost immediately; and a DNS record with no id, without which a cached policy is never refreshed. Pay 160000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

dns_record.description: The _mta-sts TXT record. Omitting it is reported as not having checked whether the policy is discoverable, and a policy nobody can find is never applied. Nothing resolves DNS: the records are supplied, which keeps the egress surface at zero and means an arbitrary domain can be audited without this service holding an allowlist for it.

domain.description: The domain the policy belongs to. A trailing dot is ignored, so it does not create a second name.

mx_hosts.description: The MX hosts. Without them the patterns are not checked against anything, which is the point of the policy.

items.description: A host that receives mail for the domain. A trailing dot is ignored, so it does not create a second name.

policy.description: The policy file contents. Nothing resolves DNS: the records are supplied, which keeps the egress surface at zero and means an arbitrary domain can be audited without this service holding an allowlist for it.
policy.example:
version: STSv1
mode: testing
mx: *.vendor.test
max_age: 3600

name: mta_sts_policy_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

valid.description: True only when the policy parsed, authorised every MX host supplied, and every check the caller asked for was performed.

title: MTA-STS Policy Audit
